members_company_access.name: members_company_access
members_company_access.value: "members"."companyAccess" IN ('own', 'manager') AND ("members"."companyAccess" <> 'manager' OR ("members"."role" = 'client' AND "members"."customerCompanyId" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("members"."role" = 'client' OR "members"."customerCompanyId" IS NULL)

service_policies_scope_check.name: service_policies_scope_check
service_policies_scope_check.value: ("servicePolicies"."scopeKey" = 'default' AND "servicePolicies"."customerCompanyId" IS NULL) OR ("servicePolicies"."customerCompanyId" IS NOT NULL AND "servicePolicies"."scopeKey" = "servicePolicies"."customerCompanyId")
